svg.text: AI writes the code. A background validator watches its quality while humans supervise through signals and change summaries.
Humans and AI coding agents write
Every ▼ attribute and failing test is escalated (illustrative)
Acts on failing unit tests and
change summaries, not by reading every line.
The acceptance rate of recommendations calibrates the validator
and is the evidence for graduating this loop toward the cockpit.
Later stages that read the code
